Project 'Global Banking Platform Modernisation' uses Kubernetes, AWS, Terraform, Jenkins, and complies with PCI-DSS, SOC2, GDPR.
Alex Chen is the DevSecOps Lead responsible for security architecture and compliance oversight.
The Jenkins CI/CD pipeline includes stages: Checkout, Dependency Check, SAST Scan, Build, and Unit Test, triggered on PR to main.
The secure AWS EKS cluster uses Terraform with private endpoints and KMS encryption enabled.
Security policies enforce least privilege access, MFA, JIT access, and OWASP Top 10 secure coding practices.
Monitoring includes Prometheus for application errors and New Relic for API response times with ViXa dashboards.
Compliance includes PCI-DSS network security controls via AWS Security Groups and GDPR Article 32 with encryption.
Risk SEC-001: Exposed API endpoints mitigated by WAF and rate limiting; owner: Jordan Wright.
DevSecOps training covers secure coding, Kubernetes hardening, and CI/CD security automation.
The AI Search project led by Dr. Vui Nguyen uses Elasticsearch, BERT, and FastAPI deployed on AWS.
IoT Smart Camera was compromised by the Mirai Botnet due to default credentials (CVE-2021-28372); mitigation includes enforcing strong passwords and 2FA.
Medical IoT pacemaker vulnerable to unencrypted firmware updates (CVE-2020-12345), targeted by APT29; mitigation: signed and encrypted OTA updates.
Industrial sensor buffer overflow (CVE-2022-35679) exploited by Lazarus Group; mitigation: upgrade to TLS 1.3 and input validation.
Smart thermostat exposed to SQL injection (CVE-2024-1024); mitigation: WAF and API rate limiting; 2024 HVAC ransomware attack reported.
AI/ML project phase: Data Collection includes tasks like identifying data sources, establishing pipelines, and implementing scraping and API tools.
In-progress Data Processing phase includes text extraction, data cleaning, entity recognition, and metadata enrichment for the AI search pipeline.
Model Development phase includes baseline model, custom training, metrics setup, and A/B testing framework, planned for 8 weeks.
System Integration involves API development, UI integration, performance optimization, and security setup, scheduled for 6 weeks.
Final Deployment phase includes staging setup, UAT, production rollout, and monitoring, taking 4 weeks.
Knowledge Base Document 'AI Implementation Best Practices' covers data governance, model deployment, and monitoring in enterprise settings.
Research paper compares transformer-based retrieval models, showing 15% performance gains over traditional search methods.
Support ticket flagged poor synonym handling causing search inaccuracies; issue resolved with NLP pipeline improvements.
Performance metrics: search latency <500ms (p95), recall@10 >0.85, precision@5 >0.90, and MRR >0.75.
Business metrics aim for 4.5+ user satisfaction, 15% increase in search conversion, and 20% reduction in support tickets.
Model metrics show 92.3% training accuracy, validation loss of 0.153, and 120ms average inference time.
In the Code Commit stage, ViXa platform detected hardcoded AWS keys exposing 5 critical secrets. Remediated with secrets rotation and Git hooks. Compliance: PCI-DSS 3.2.1.
During Build stage, ViXa platform flagged Log4j vulnerability (CVE-2023-44228, CVSS 10.0). Remediated by upgrading to Log4j 2.17.0. Compliance: NIST SP 800-218.
At Deployment stage, container image vulnerability (CVE-2024-1234) found in Alpine Linux. Patched base image as per CIS Docker Benchmark.
Runtime cryptojacking behavior detected by ViXa due to unauthorized CPU spikes. Mitigation: killed pod and alerted SOC. MITRE ATT&CK: T1496.
SolarWinds supply chain attack compromised 18K organizations via trojanized software update. MSSP deployed zero trust and network segmentation. Lesson: monitor DLL sideloading in CI/CD.
Colonial Pipeline ransomware attack exploited RDP via phishing. $4.4M ransom paid. MSSP response: EDR deployment and dark web monitoring. Lesson: segment OT and IT networks.
Log4j exploitation (JNDI injection) exposed 100M+ servers. MSSP enforced emergency patching and WAF rule updates. Lesson: automate CVE scanning in DevSecOps.
Tesla S3 bucket leaked autopilot data due to misconfigured IAM. MSSP enforced CSPM and S3 encryption. Lesson: least privilege for cloud roles.
